metadata.title: Pharmacogenomic-Guided Antidepressant Selection in Major Depressive Disorder: A Real-World Observational Study on Treatment Outcomes and Healthcare Utilization
metadata.summary: This real-world observational study investigated the impact of pharmacogenomic testing on antidepressant selection and outcomes in 1,500 patients with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). Half the patients received pharmacogenomic-guided therapy, while the other half received standard care. The pharmacogenomic-guided group showed significantly improved remission rates, faster response times, reduced adverse drug reactions, and lower healthcare utilization compared to the control group.

metadata.title: Federated Learning for Privacy-Preserving Drug Discovery in Precision Medicine: A Collaborative AI Framework
metadata.summary: This paper introduces a novel federated learning framework designed to enable collaborative drug discovery while preserving patient privacy. The framework allows multiple healthcare institutions to jointly train a machine learning model on their local datasets without sharing raw patient information. Results show comparable predictive performance to a centralized model, enhancing data privacy and security.

metadata.title: Assessing the Role of Subsurface Hydrology in Landslide Initiation and Slope Stability in Tropical Montane Regions
metadata.summary: This research investigates the complex interplay between subsurface hydrological processes and the mechanisms triggering landslides in vulnerable tropical montane environments. Focusing on selected sites in the Central Highlands of Vietnam and the Cordillera Central of the Philippines, the study employs a combination of in-situ hydro-geological monitoring (pore water pressure, soil moisture content), geophysical surveys (electrical resistivity tomography, seismic refraction), and physically-based slope stability modeling. The aim is to quantify how variations in rainfall intensity and duration influence groundwater levels and pore water pressure, leading to critical reductions in shear strength and subsequent slope failure. Findings from this study are crucial for developing more accurate early warning systems, informing land-use planning, and designing effective mitigation strategies to reduce the devastating impact of landslides on local communities and infrastructure in these high-risk regions.

metadata.title: Explainable AI for Enhanced Clinical Decision Support in Oncology: A Hybrid Approach Combining Deep Learning and Symbolic Reasoning
metadata.summary: This paper introduces a new AI framework for oncology decision support. It combines deep learning (for pattern recognition) with a symbolic knowledge base (populated with medical guidelines) to provide transparent and explainable recommendations, addressing the 'black-box' nature of traditional deep learning models and leading to increased clinician confidence and potentially improved patient outcomes. The framework was tested using retrospective lung cancer patient data and achieved comparable diagnostic accuracy to state-of-the-art deep learning models.
